question: Does an isolated integer Hasse flag admit a conserving covariant discrete event with HOLD and discriminating readout?

objects.definition: four integer vertex amplitudes, six oriented integer edge amplitudes, six hard-mask bits
objects.origin: new restricted carrier; source Q169/Q170 context

objects.definition: unique flagged incidence quarter-turn, otherwise HOLD

objects.exact_expression: Delta Y_i=z_e²-v_i² on EVENT; 0 on HOLD

sources.source_status: native geometry, stock and integrity types; event law not supplied

assumptions.statement: integer sublattice of vertex+edge amplitudes, higher grades zero; static hard masks
unique h_e=1 and nonzero incident amplitudes choose one Hasse flag, ties HOLD
single event is primitive SO(2,Z) axis transfer with incidence sign

technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: classify SO(2,Z) and signed S4 covariance
balance vertex and edge squared stock
formal integer tick, period four state and period two stock
no rational coefficient or divisibility target

integer_fraction_receipt.raw_count_expression: 6 edges x 2 endpoints x 4 nonzero vertex values x 4 nonzero edge values=192 preparations; x24 S4=4608 covariance checks

clock_receipt.period_claim: F^4=id globally; active signed orbit period4, generic squared stock period2

dynamics_readout.state_space: Z^4 vertices x Z^6 edges x {0,1}^6 hard mask
dynamics_readout.initial_boundary_conditions: arbitrary integer input, no external flux; isolated example v0=1,e01=2,h01=1
dynamics_readout.conservation_and_sources: N exact, two-site signed stock exchange; no external source
dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: Y_i=v_i² loses signs and may not distinguish equal magnitudes or two-step phase

target_exposure.search_domain_and_budget: single prescribed primitive SO(2,Z) axis transfer, two nulls
target_exposure.selection_criterion: locality, integer norm conservation, explicit HOLD and readout

calculation_steps: choose incidence sign and unique-flag guard as candidate
prove signed S4 covariance and N conservation
show guard classes invariant so F^4=id
compute prepared sequence and compare identity/HOLD/-I

result.scope: new finite local candidate; not Q169 sampled flow or physical event

counterexamples_and_failures: equal magnitude a²=b² makes stock readout blind to EVENT
two active endpoints of same hard edge produce HOLD_TIE
no active mask or amplitude produces HOLD_ZERO
limitations: new integer lattice and primitive transfer not sourced
hard mask preparation and event trigger unselected
not Q198 parity event or Q169 continuous generator
no physical time, charge, units, apparatus or independent review
next_discriminant: source-selected preparation/trigger and independent signed or stock readout; otherwise park this candidate
